articles.title: Security cabinet to discuss renewing Gaza war as Hamas refuses disarmament
articles.description: Israeli security cabinet scheduled to discuss war resumption as Hamas rejects disarmament demands and negotiations stall over weapons surrender framework.

articles.title: IDF reports 19 Gaza ceasefire violations between April 21-May 5
articles.description: Israeli military documented 19 ceasefire violations including elimination of Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad members threatening IDF forces across Gaza.

articles.title: Israel threatens Gaza war resumption to force disarmament as truce frays
articles.description: Israeli military officials state additional fighting is 'almost inevitable' and forces have expanded territorial control to 59% of Gaza Strip through systematic boundary expansion.

articles.title: Netanyahu meets Board of Peace envoy on Gaza disarmament deadlock
articles.description: Israeli PM Netanyahu met with Board of Peace representative Nickolay Mladenov on May 5 to discuss Hamas refusal to disarm and next steps in conflict.

articles.title: Israel expands territorial control in Gaza beyond ceasefire boundaries
articles.description: Israeli forces have systematically expanded control from 53% to 62% of Gaza Strip by pushing Yellow Line westward, triggering fresh Palestinian displacement.

articles.title: Hamas condemns flotilla interception and activist detention
articles.description: Hamas statement condemned Israeli forces' violent interception of Gaza-bound aid flotilla and detention of pro-Palestinian activists as 'moral decadence.'

articles.title: Hamas rejects US disarmament framework, links weapons to Palestinian statehood
articles.description: Hamas political bureau member Abdul Jabbar Said stated Hamas will only address disarmament within framework requiring Palestinian state establishment.

articles.title: Palestinian analysis: Hamas links security to comprehensive political rights
articles.description: Gaza analyst Wissam Afifa noted Hamas navigating diplomatic pressure by linking disarmament directly to comprehensive Palestinian political rights and statehood.
